versions.name: A Wolf Goes Fishing

provenance.notes: Name, rank placement and category from the official rank adventure pages. The evergreen description is original prose regenerated from the adventure's own 'Snapshot' section, excluding requirement text.

versions.description: A Wolf learns the basics of fishing, identifying local waters and the fish that live there, choosing bait, casting a rod, following water-safety rules, and heading out to fish with family or den.
